correctness.rationale: The exact quadratic composition x^4-4x^2+2 gives valuation 2v and first digit 2 for 3-divisible inputs, with 2 Hensel-simple roots mod 3^{k-2v} and 3^v lifts apiece. The fixed target y=2 has 3^{floor(k/2)} roots. All residue classes enter the permuted 2(mod3) class within two steps, uniquely on the 1(mod3) branch. Along cycles the valuation/leading-digit invariant is preserved; the 3-adic iterate-lifting lemma proves period 3^{k-s-1}, exactly the cardinality of each eligible valuation/sign stratum. Independent exact enumeration for k=1..8 confirmed every fibre, depth, and rich-cycle property. No finite check is used as the infinite proof.

value.rationale: A complete functional graph classification requires rooted tree sizes at individual cycles, not just the periodic orbit spectrum. This exact depth-two branching law demonstrates a sharp arithmetic nonuniformity: one rich cycle at each even valuation and no trees at the others, for every ternary precision. The invariant is natural, mathematically nontrivial (valuation, lifting, cycle-length interaction), and applicable to exact finite-ring functional-graph generation.
